title: Launcher's unconfirmed test-run registration line names neither its cause nor the correction
outcome: Launcher's unconfirmed test-run registration line names neither its cause nor the correction
acceptance: When scripts/test-run-registration.mjs reports a registration as unconfirmed (e.g. 'registration: unconfirmed; native-wait=unavailable; use --notify; not host check credit'), the line names the cause (HTTP status, refusal code, transport error or missing host configuration) and the correction that would give credit (how to start a registered run)
